# otinstaller - LLM Usage Guide

This file describes how to use otinstaller programmatically or via CLI for AI agents.

## Overview

otinstaller is a CLI tool manager that installs, runs, updates, and removes open-source command line tools by name. Each tool runs in its own virtualenv. Results are saved automatically.

## Installation

`ash
# System-wide (recommended for agents)
pipx install otinstaller

# Or from source
pip install -e .
`

Commands available as both otinstaller and ot.

## Key Concepts

- Tools: Managed CLI programs, each in its own virtualenv
- Typed inputs: Standardized prefixes for tool arguments
- Results: Saved to ./results/<tool>/<target>/ with metadata
- API keys: Stored in ~/.otinstaller/.env (600 permissions)

## Typed Input Prefixes

Use these instead of tool-specific flags:

| Prefix | Type | Example |
|--------|------|---------|
| u: | username | u:johndoe |
| e: | email | e:john@example.com |
| p: | phone | p:+15551234567 |
| d: | domain | d:example.com |
| url: | URL | url:https://example.com |
| q: | query | q:search terms |
| geo: | coordinates | geo:32.22,-110.97 |
| tg: | Telegram channel | tg:channelname |

## Common Commands

### Initialize
`ash
otinstaller init --yes
`

### Install tools
`ash
otinstaller install sherlock maigret --yes
`

### Run tools with typed inputs
`ash
otinstaller run sherlock -- u:johndoe
otinstaller run ghunt -- u:johndoe e:john@example.com
`

### Run all matching tools (--all / -a)
`ash
otinstaller run -a u:johndoe
otinstaller run --all u:johndoe e:john@example.com
otinstaller run --all u:johndoe --include-credentialed
`

### Check for updates
`ash
otinstaller check-updates
otinstaller check-updates --tools sherlock,maigret --json
`

### Update tools
`ash
otinstaller update --all --yes
otinstaller update sherlock maigret --yes
otinstaller update --tools sherlock,maigret --yes
`

### List and search tools
`ash
otinstaller list --json
otinstaller list --installed --json
otinstaller search username --json
`

### Get tool info
`ash
otinstaller info sherlock --json
otinstaller sherlock --json  # bare name also works
`

### Run with auto-detection
`ash
otinstaller auto johndoe@example.com --yes
`

### Check API keys
`ash
otinstaller keys check --json
`

## Agent-Friendly Features

- All commands support --json: Machine-readable output
- Stable exit codes: 0=success, 1=error, 2=invalid input, 130=interrupted
- No prompts in CI: Commands detect non-interactive stdin and fail with clear error unless --yes is used
- No prompts with --yes: Use -y or --yes to skip all confirmations
- Short alias: ot works everywhere otinstaller works
- Bare tool names: otinstaller sherlock == otinstaller info sherlock

## Exit Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 0 | Success |
| 1 | General error |
| 2 | Invalid input / unsupported input type |
| 130 | Interrupted (SIGINT/Ctrl+C) |

## JSON Output Format

Most commands support --json. Examples:

`json
// otinstaller list --json
[{name: sherlock, display_name: Sherlock, description: ..., tier: community, capabilities: [username-search]}]

// otinstaller info sherlock --json
{name: sherlock, display_name: Sherlock, description: ..., tier: community, install: {method: pip, package: sherlock-project, version: 0.16.2}, entrypoint: {command: sherlock}, capabilities: [username-search, social-media], topics: [username, social-media], api_keys: {required: [], optional: []}, needs_config: false, verified: {date: 2026-09-24, version: 0.16.2, os: Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, python: 3.12.14}, accepts: [username], input_types: {u: --username}}

// otinstaller check-updates --json
{results: [{tool: sherlock, current: 0.16.2, latest: 0.17.0, outdated: true}], updates_available: 1, pinned: 0, failed: 0}
`

## Responsible Use

otinstaller installs third-party tools. You are solely responsible for compliance with laws and terms of service. Tools marked dual-use require explicit acceptance of the responsible use notice.

## Directory Structure

~/.otinstaller/
├── .env              # API keys (600 perms)
├── accepted.json     # Notice acceptance
├── tools/            # Per-tool virtualenvs
├── logs/             # Install logs
├── jobs/             # Job markers for resume
└── state.db          # SQLite state

Working directory:
./results/
├── <tool>/
│   └── <target>/
│       ├── <timestamp>_<tool>_<target>_<runid>.txt
│       └── <timestamp>_<tool>_<target>_<runid>.meta.json

## Available Tools (44)

Run otinstaller list --json for the complete list. Key tools include:
- sherlock, maigret, ghunt, theharvester, spiderfoot
- blackbird, telegram-phone-number-checker, auto-archiver
- edgar-tool, instagram-location-search, telepathy
- holehe, bbot, dnstwist, h8mail, user-scanner
- And many more...
